description:
Use this when the user asks how FIIs, DIIs, proprietary traders or clients are positioned in NSE futures and options across the whole market.

Returns one row per day and participant type (FII, DII, proprietary, client) with long and short contract counts in index and stock futures and options, across the whole F&O segment: open interest, which is positions held, and the day's volume. `days` is 1 to 366 (default 10). Neither is cash-market buying and selling, which is in get_market_fii_dii_flow. For one stock or index use get_derivatives_positioning.
name: get_fo_participant_activity
title: F&O participant activity
